races.paceDynamic: Travis will lead unopposed from the start, with Straight A, The Sweet Escape, Thats My Boy Luke and Electric Lightning taking prominent positions behind him. The lack of natural pace-pressers means Travis can dictate comfortable fractions without stress, creating an even gallop that builds gradually. This sustainable tempo will allow front-runners and prominent racers to maintain their positions, while hold-up horses face the challenge of making up ground on a straight mile without the benefit of a bending track to aid their progress. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good early positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Travis Wires The Field
scenarios.trigger: If Travis maintains his lead throughout without serious challenge
scenarios.body: Travis sets comfortable fractions and kicks clear in the final furlong, with the prominent racers unable to match his sustained effort. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to save energy for a decisive move when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners successfully track Travis and time their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: Straight A or The Sweet Escape use their tactical speed to collar Travis inside the final two furlongs, benefiting from the steady early gallop. Their superior recent form and ratings tell in a sustained drive to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Powers Home
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes surprisingly strong or Travis weakens significantly
scenarios.body: The sustained nature of a straight mile allows a classy hold-up horse like Up The Jazz or Mariner to unleash a powerful late run. Their class advantage becomes decisive when the early leaders tire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a tactical crawl that suits pace-independent runners
scenarios.body: Electric Lightning's 5lb weight advantage and Warren Fentiman's claim become crucial factors in a slowly-run contest. The light weight allows him to quicken decisively when others are struggling.

watchPoints.text: Travis could have the race sewn up by halfway if no horse challenges his early supremacy
Electric Lightning's light weight could be decisive if Warren Fentiman rides a patient race
Up The Jazz needs the early pace to be stronger than expected to unleash his finishing kick
Straight A has the tactical speed to collar Travis but must time his move perfectly
The straight mile configuration makes it harder for hold-up horses to make up significant ground

races.paceDynamic: Bergamo Gold will lead uncontested from the front, setting a moderate gallop that should prove sustainable over this 1m2f trip. With only Fanciulla Del West and Letmeseethecolts likely to race prominently, there's no early pressure expected on the leader. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Myrrh, Fire Eyes, Princess Niyla, Ammoony, Clocker and Eze Sur Mer will settle behind before launching their challenges in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will develop when seven hold-up horses converge late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Bergamo Gold maintains a steady tempo without being challenged early
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the field bunches behind, making it impossible for the late runners to close the gap effectively. Jason Hart can dictate terms from the front and kick clear when the closers are still navigating traffic.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Traffic Problems
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses struggle to find clear running in the congested finish
scenarios.body: With seven horses needing to come from behind, several will be checked or forced to switch wide, allowing those with cleaner passages to prevail. The pace-setters maintain their advantage as the field gets tangled up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Closers Find Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get organized runs through the field despite the numbers
scenarios.body: The superior class and finishing speed of horses like Ammoony and Myrrh proves decisive as they thread between rivals. Cieren Fallon's tactical acumen helps Ammoony find the right position to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Fanciulla Del West tracks Bergamo Gold closely before pouncing late
scenarios.body: The Ed Walker-trained filly uses her tactical speed to sit second throughout before outfinishing the leader in the final furlong. Her recent second gives her confidence while avoiding the hold-up logjam.

watchPoints.text: Bergamo Gold if allowed to lead unchallenged - could steal this by dictating a pace that suits
Traffic developing at two furlongs out when seven hold-up horses converge simultaneously
Ammoony and Myrrh getting squeezed for room as the field bunches in the straight
Fanciulla Del West's position tracking the leader - crucial she stays within striking distance
Any hold-up horse making an early move to avoid the inevitable late congestion

races.paceDynamic: Lumenbourg and Lindoro will contest the early lead, with Lumenbourg showing more consistent front-running form and likely to dictate terms. The prominent racers Lord Abama, Get Up Everybody and Taygar will track close behind, creating a solid gallop over this straight six furlongs. With multiple hold-up horses including Glory Hyde, One Of Our Own, Sergeant Mayer and Jenni needing to be delivered late, the pace should be genuine throughout. This honest gallop strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace and kick clear, as hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground on good going at Redcar's stiff finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong but not suicidal, allowing trackers to position perfectly
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can sit close to Lumenbourg's gallop and kick clear in the final furlong when the hold-up horses are still struggling to get daylight. Get Up Everybody and Taygar have the tactical speed to exploit this scenario perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Lumenbourg gets an uncontested lead and the prominent horses fail to apply enough pressure
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage turning for home, with the hold-up brigade too far back to make any impression. Lumenbourg's recent consistent form suggests he can sustain a strong gallop to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes truly breakneck with Lumenbourg and Lindoro going too fast
scenarios.body: The pace collapses dramatically in the final two furlongs, allowing the best of the hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Glory Hyde's recent winning form and One Of Our Own's consistency give them the best late kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders falter early and create a messy, stop-start gallop
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with no clear pace bias, turning into a sprint finish where any horse with tactical speed can win. This scenario creates the most open finish but seems unlikely given Lumenbourg's front-running style.

watchPoints.text: Lumenbourg could steal this if he gets an uncontested lead, as his front-running style is perfectly suited to Redcar's straight course
Watch Get Up Everybody for tactical positioning early - if she tracks the pace perfectly she has the form to win this
Glory Hyde is the most dangerous closer but needs the leaders to go fast enough to set up her finishing kick
One Of Our Own won here 11 days ago and drops back to her optimum trip, making her very dangerous if getting a clear run
Both Profiteer and Startling return from long layoffs and need this run, so expect them to be well beaten

races.paceDynamic: Harswell River will take the field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, with Perfect Ruler and Full Gas likely to sit prominent behind him in the early stages. With 8 of 10 runners preferring hold-up tactics, there's minimal pace pressure on Harswell River, allowing him to dictate a comfortable gallop through the middle sections. The large contingent of hold-up horses will create traffic problems in the straight as they all come with late runs simultaneously. This sustainable pace scenario clearly favours the early-positioned horses who can avoid the inevitable scrimmaging behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Harswell River gets soft sectionals and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to save energy for a telling finishing kick, while the hold-up brigade get in each other's way. Early positioning proves decisive as traffic becomes a major factor for the back-markers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Perfect Ruler or Full Gas can track Harswell River and outkick him in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Their forward positioning gives them first run on the field while avoiding the cavalry charge from behind. The Haggas/Fallon combination on Perfect Ruler or the in-form Full Gas can capitalise on tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If one of the stronger hold-up runners like Forever Twenty gets a clean run through
scenarios.body: Their superior finishing speed can overcome the tactical disadvantage if they avoid trouble in running. The pace will be just steady enough to allow a well-timed late surge to prevail.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Finish Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners stop and multiple hold-up horses get hampered
scenarios.body: A horse drawn well or with good positioning like Twilight Serenade could emerge from the pack. The scramble allows a lesser-rated runner to sneak through while the fancied horses encounter trouble.

watchPoints.text: Harswell River must be watched for any early pressure as he's the only confirmed leader
Traffic problems are inevitable in the straight with 8 hold-up horses coming from behind
Perfect Ruler's early positioning will be crucial given Fallon's tactical awareness
Maximum Velocity needs to be produced with perfect timing to overcome his poor draw
Forever Twenty's recent course form makes him the pick of the hold-up horses if getting clear run

races.paceDynamic: Secret Testimony will be the sole pace-setter from the gates, establishing an uncontested lead with seven hold-up horses behind him. With no pace pressure, Secret Testimony can dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages, but his tendency to fade in the finish creates vulnerability in the straight. The lack of prominent runners means the hold-up brigade will be bunched together making their moves from the back, creating a tactical scramble in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours horses with a strong finishing kick who can produce their best work late, as they'll get perfect conditions to close into a weakening leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Fades Late
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Testimony sets steady fractions but weakens as expected in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get ideal conditions to unleash their finishing kicks into a tiring leader. Black Rock Beauty and Realistic Dream can capitalize with their superior ratings and recent good form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Testimony gets such easy fractions that he maintains his stamina reserves for the finish
scenarios.body: Despite his fading tendency, the complete lack of pace pressure allows him to dictate terms and hold off the late charge. Walk On Walk On could emerge best of the closers for second.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too slow and all the hold-up horses arrive together in a bunch
scenarios.body: A cavalry charge develops with multiple horses hitting the line together, favouring those with the best recent form. Truly Special and Long Shot benefit from their recent competitive runs and tactical speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Truly Special breaks from his usual hold-up style to race more prominently
scenarios.body: Being the only horse willing to track Secret Testimony gives Truly Special a perfect stalking position to strike. His superior fitness from recent racing gives him the edge over the rustier hold-up horses.

watchPoints.text: Watch Secret Testimony in the final furlong as his fading pattern suggests he'll weaken dramatically when the closers arrive
Monitor how prominently Truly Special breaks as any change to stalking tactics could give him a crucial positional advantage
Watch Black Rock Beauty despite the long layoff as her superior RPR rating makes her dangerous if fitness holds up
Keep an eye on the early fractions as Secret Testimony's uncontested lead could either set up perfectly for closers or allow him to steal it
Watch for traffic problems in the straight as seven hold-up horses will create a potential bottleneck when making their moves
